tbesh_html:
1) to be in pain, be sore, have pain, be sorrowful
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be in pain (physical)
1a2) to be in pain (mental)
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to cause pain, hurt, mar
1b2) pain, mar (participle)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to feel pain; by implication, to grieve; figuratively, to spoil
strongs_1890.kjv_def: grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.
